intent: Edit the supplied bpx-council screenshot into a better backend-check progress screen. Fix tiny upper-left log marooned in an enormous empty blue canvas. This is a visual reference for an Ink terminal implementation, not a web app.
reference_preservation: Keep landscape terminal window, front-on screenshot framing, authentic DOS/Turbo Vision appearance and every existing backend/status fact. Remove the black CleanShot floating recorder/key overlay at bottom center. Change layout and background only; do not invent test outcomes.

scene.surround: Dark charcoal inactive terminal canvas #151820, thin rectangular outer terminal frame. No background applications or desktop scenery.
scene.subject: One compact rectangular DOS dialog centered horizontally and vertically, bounded width with comfortable but compact cell padding. Visually substantial and legible, neither tiny nor stretched across entire window. Blue dialog #000080 with crisp light-gray double-line box-drawing border, white monospace text; title interrupts top border.

hierarchy.title: Local backend check
hierarchy.bar: Horizontal terminal block-character progress bar, six of nine segments filled amber; three unfilled. Never smooth graphical gradient.
hierarchy.table: Aligned two-column Backend / Status table with consistent terminal-cell spacing and nine rows. Place directly under progress. Highlight qwen row using a solid darker/lighter ANSI background and amber spinner character. Table fills dialog width, not entire window.
hierarchy.footer: Short safety note inside dialog, separated by thin box-drawing line. Bottom keyboard strip inside same dialog; Esc and Ctrl-C visually accented, all other controls absent.

exact_footer: Local version checks only. No model calls.

colors.backend_identity: Codex mint #a8e6cf; Claude peach #ffccaa; Pi lavender #c4b5fd; OpenCode cyan #87d7e8; other names light gray. Color backend names only, not whole table rows.
colors.status: Version found muted mint; warning amber #ffd166; Check failed salmon #ff9580; Checking amber; Waiting muted gray. Always retain literal status words; no color-only communication.

typography: Legible fixed-width terminal font on a strict character grid, same consistent font scale throughout. Hierarchy from spacing, borders and color rather than large proportional headline fonts. Crisp rectangular geometry, no decorative graphics.
constraints: One screen, one centered dialog; no side-by-side variants or captions outside terminal.
No rounded SaaS cards, gradients, glass blur, neon bloom, graphic logo badges, emoji, illustrations, photographic desk or CRT distortion.
No fake authentication success, model connection receipts, invented versions, percentage labels or extra actions.
No huge left-aligned blue sheet with most of screen unused.
No mouse-only controls. Terminal-feasible Unicode borders, ANSI colors and text/block progress only.
All quoted copy readable and correctly spelled; no lorem ipsum, no placeholder text.
